content.text: Both lines are still accurate. I'll add one clause to the subsystem page so it mentions what sizes the preview, then commit Phase 5.

input.command:
cd "C:/Users/shrey/desktop/Elemental_harness" && node -e '
const fs=require("fs");const p="docs/subsystems/spill.md";let s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");
const a="replaces an over-`maxInlineBytes` plain-text final result with a retention-library head/tail preview plus the spill reference";
if(!s.includes(a))throw new Error("anchor missing");
s=s.replace(a,"replaces an over-`maxInlineBytes` plain-text final result with a retention-library head/tail preview plus the spill reference, the whole replacement sized by `previewBytes`");
fs.writeFileSync(p,s);' && pnpm run -s verify-md-wrap 2>&1 | grep -v engine-book | grep "spill" ; git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Keep a 2 KB preview for spilled tool results

spill-policy gains previewBytes, the size of a spilled result's
replacement, separate from the maxInlineBytes spill threshold. dsh-base
keeps the 50,000-byte threshold, which already matches Claude Code's
cap, and sets a 2,000-byte head/tail preview like Claude Code's, so a
spilled output costs about 500 tokens instead of about 12,500.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log -1 --oneline; git push -q -u origin compaction-phase5 2>&1 | grep -E "✔️ typecheck|✖|error" | tail -2; git tag -a compaction-v5 -m "Phase 5: 2 KB preview for spilled tool results" && git push -q origin refs/tags/compaction-v5 2>&1 | tail -1; git ls-remote origin refs/tags/compaction-v5 refs/heads/compaction-phase5
